name: configure_conversation_camera_and_text_windows

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_ConfigureConversationCameraAndTextWindows reads two text-window IDs from the Script value stack and decrements stackTop by two on every path

notes: When the selected object at Script offset 0x04 exists, ScriptCommand_ConfigureConversationCameraAndTextWindows passes the player and selected-object positions to func_0017FB88. That routine frames their midpoint, evaluates four camera candidates with collision checks, activates a usable candidate, and returns its index or fallback index 4. ScriptCommand_ConfigureConversationCameraAndTextWindows then applies the corresponding preset to the two D_00623C30 text-window templates: it sets their screen offsets, pointer styles, perimeter positions, pointer angles, and scales so the paired windows match the chosen view. A fallback result immediately calls func_0017FED8 to cancel the temporary camera; successful setups remain active until command 180 calls the same cleanup routine. The JP corpus contains five calls across al01.ard and pc06.ard. Every call uses a literal window pair, either 0/1 or 3/2, and every script entry later calls command 180.
